Class ProgramLayout

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.ProgramLayout
public final class ProgramLayout extends Object
Whole-program storage decisions made before any code is emitted: arena object sizes and field offsets, mutable static fields' .bss symbols, and the .rodata symbols of string literals and compiler-generated constant int arrays — plus the data sections holding them.

    static final record 
    ProgramLayout.DataDirectives
    The assembler directives a data section is written with: word emits 32-bit values (ARM's .word; AVR's .word is 16-bit, so it uses .long), align 4-byte-aligns, and bss switches to the zero-initialized section (AVR's assembler has no .bss shorthand).

    ProgramLayout(IrProgram program)
    An object's fields are exactly the ones some LoadField/StoreField in the whole program actually touches (there's no class-file field table available here, only the IR), laid out in FieldRef.displayName() order — sequential 4-byte int slots, since every field this backend has seen is one.

  • Constructor Details

    • ProgramLayout

      public ProgramLayout(IrProgram program)
      An object's fields are exactly the ones some LoadField/StoreField in the whole program actually touches (there's no class-file field table available here, only the IR), laid out in FieldRef.displayName() order — sequential 4-byte int slots, since every field this backend has seen is one. Also assigns each LoadStatic/StoreStatic field a stable .bss symbol.
